info.name: Perplexity CSS FIX Windows7 Chrome v109 compatible
info.description:
Makes Perplexity compatible with Windows 7 & Chrome v109 (latest available version for Windows 7).
CSS fix for transparent bacground and pop-up elements.

EDIT:
As of December 2025, Supermium browser (supermium.org) provides full Perplexity compatibility on Windows 7 without needing CSS fixes. 
It is fully compatible with Chrome, including extensions.
info.additionalInfo: Before and After screenshots about the Perplexity CSS fix.
